name: Cyclorphan
summary: Cyclorphan is an opioid analgesic of the morphinan family that was never marketed. It acts as a μ-opioid receptor (MOR) weak partial agonist or antagonist, κ-opioid receptor (KOR) full agonist, and, to a much lesser extent, δ-opioid receptor (DOR) agonist (75-fold lower affinity relative to the KOR). The drug was first synthesized in 1964 by scientists at Research Corporation.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a μ-opioid receptor (MOR) weak partial agonist or antagonist, κ-opioid receptor (KOR) full agonist, and, to a much lesser extent, δ-opioid receptor (DOR) agonist (75-fold lower affinity relative to the KOR). In clinical trials, it had relatively long duration, good absorption, and provided strong pain relief but produced psychotomimetic effects via KOR activation, so its development was not continued.

summaryZh: 賽克羅酚（英語：Cyclorphan）是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C20H27NO，屬於嗎啡喃衍生物，可作為類阿片鎮痛藥，從未上市銷售。

sideEffects.en: In trials it caused psychotomimetic effects, such as hallucinations, unease and strange thoughts, through kappa receptors. Opioids of its kind can also cause drowsiness, nausea and slowed breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 在試驗中，它透過 κ 受體造成擬精神病作用，例如幻覺、不安與怪異的想法。這類鴉片類藥物也可能造成嗜睡、噁心與呼吸抑制。
sideEffects.zhHans: 在试验中，它通过 κ 受体造成拟精神病作用，例如幻觉、不安与怪异的想法。这类鸦片类药物也可能造成嗜睡、恶心与呼吸抑制。

fact.en: Its close relative butorphanol, which has a cyclobutylmethyl group and an extra hydroxyl group, did reach the market, as a painkiller injection and nasal spray.
fact.zh: 它的近親布托啡諾帶有環丁基甲基與一個額外的羥基，而布托啡諾確實上市了，劑型有止痛注射劑與鼻噴劑。
fact.zhHans: 它的近亲布托啡诺带有环丁基甲基与一个额外的羟基，而布托啡诺确实上市了，剂型有止痛注射剂与鼻喷剂。
